# Your Cover's Blown

> A non-fiction book review podcast

Your Cover's Blown is a non-fiction book review podcast hosted by Fraser and Ed. Each episode reviews one non-fiction book. Episodes are listed below and carried in the podcast RSS feed.

## Site

- [Home](https://yourcoversblown.com/): A non-fiction podcast about non-fiction books.
- [About](https://yourcoversblown.com/about/): About the show: Your Cover's Blown is a non-fiction podcast about non-fiction books.

## Episodes

- [Episodes](https://yourcoversblown.com/episodes/): Every Your Cover's Blown episode, newest first.
- [Never Split the Difference](https://yourcoversblown.com/episodes/never-split-the-difference/): An ex-FBI hostage negotiator teaches you how to get your way at work, at home and at the car dealership. This week we're learning to negotiate like a hostage.

## Feeds

- [Podcast RSS feed](https://yourcoversblown.com/feed.xml): The episode feed, with audio enclosures — the same feed the podcast apps subscribe to.
- [Sitemap](https://yourcoversblown.com/sitemap.xml): Every URL on the site.
